_comment: Example 3: Transformer architecture config. Copy and modify.
_comment_purpose: Architecture starter only; adapt for your own modality/task.
name: transformer_example_run

data._comment_modify_here: Path to tokenized dataset, parquet/csv/jsonl, or dataset directory (external path supported).

model._comment_modify_here: Example transformer kwargs; keep only fields your model constructor expects.

inference._comment_modify_here: Set every_epochs=0 to disable, or >0 to stream epoch inference to the GUI Inference tab.

extra._comment_modify_here: Project metadata, tokenizer hints, and inference/runtime flags.
extra._comment_routing: Set project_name (or explicit entrypoint paths) so GUI launches models/<ProjectName>/train.py and infer.py.
